name: Appwrite Education Cloud
benefit: Free Appwrite Education plan with two cloud projects and Pro-equivalent resource limits excluding email support.
eligibility: Students currently verified through GitHub Student Developer Pack; sign up for the Appwrite Education program.
duration: Six months from joining, one enrollment per account; six-month terms began being enforced November 1, 2026.
restrictions: Educational/noncommercial use only. Add-ons are excluded. Choose another plan before expiry or the organization may be disabled; resource retention is not indefinite.

name: Astah UML Free Student License
benefit: Free personal Astah UML license for creating UML models while studying.
eligibility: Current college or university students with an academic email address apply for a student license.
duration: Academic/student license duration is subject to the issued license and ongoing eligibility.
restrictions: Personal noncommercial education use only. Teachers are not eligible for the student license, and shared computers are excluded.

name: Autodesk Education Access
benefit: One year of free educational access to eligible Autodesk software and services, renewable annually.
eligibility: Proof of enrollment or educator affiliation at a qualified educational institution; verification may be handled by SheerID.
duration: One year, renewable while eligible.
restrictions: Education access is not a general commercial license. Products and regional eligibility vary; verify terms before use.

name: Microsoft Azure for Students
benefit: US$100 in Azure credit for the first 12 months, plus selected free services; no card required at signup.
eligibility: Full-time students age 18+ at accredited two- or four-year degree-granting institutions, verified with an academic email.
duration: One-time 12-month student credit; do not count as recurring credit.
restrictions: Not for MOOCs or for-profit professional training. Limited activation supply; usage outside included services or credit may require a different subscription.

name: Bootstrap Studio Student License
benefit: Free Bootstrap Studio visual responsive website-builder license for eligible students.
eligibility: Students verified via GitHub Student Developer Pack and the Bootstrap Studio partner redemption.
duration: While qualifying under the partner student offer; specific expiration is not stated in GitHub's listing.
restrictions: Student entitlement is conditional and may be withdrawn when verification expires; check vendor license for usage and updates.

name: BrowserStack for GitHub Students
benefit: One-year BrowserStack student testing license including Live and Automate Mobile; the official Pack lists one Automate Mobile parallel and one user.
eligibility: Students verified in the GitHub Student Developer Pack must redeem with GitHub.
duration: One year from successful activation.
restrictions: Concurrency is limited; this student plan does not unlock unlimited parallel sessions or every enterprise testing feature.

name: Camber Student Research Compute
benefit: Monthly student allowances of 40 CPU hours, 5 GPU hours, 50 GB storage and 50 AI-agent messages for data-science projects.
eligibility: Enrolled students verified for the Camber offer through the GitHub Student Developer Pack.
duration: Monthly allowances while the student remains enrolled and eligible.
restrictions: CPU/GPU and agent budgets are capped; cloud data, storage and integrations may have separate conditions. No unlimited compute entitlement.

name: Canva Education for K–12
benefit: Free access to Canva Education classroom design, collaboration and premium teaching resources for eligible K–12 schools.
eligibility: Accredited K–12 teachers, school librarians, approved schools and invited K–12 students; teacher or school verifies eligibility.
duration: While verified and entitled to the K–12 education program.
restrictions: University/college students and higher-education institutions are not eligible for this K–12 program. Students must be invited by an eligible teacher.

name: Cloudflare Workers for Students
benefit: Waives the base US$5 per month Workers Paid subscription fee for up to 12 months, with paid-plan developer usage allowances.
eligibility: US students aged 18+ with a verified .edu billing email address and an eligible Cloudflare account.
duration: 12 months of waived base subscription fees, then the account can revert to Free if not renewed.
restrictions: Requires adding a valid credit card and activating Workers Paid. Usage above included allowances can be billed. Not generally available outside eligible US institutions.

name: Crowdin Academic Open License
benefit: Free Crowdin Open Academic License for public educational localization projects, including unlimited project participants.
eligibility: Academic project at an educational institution; apply with an educational email matching the institution's domain.
duration: Subject to the academic license approval and terms; no fixed public term stated.
restrictions: Free Open Academic licenses require publicly accessible projects. Private Academic licenses are discounted 50%, not free; educational use only.

name: DBeaver Academic License
benefit: Free DBeaver Enterprise academic license with access to the product for one year, for educational use.
eligibility: Students or teachers must apply through DBeaver and verify academic affiliation, normally with a university email or supporting documentation.
duration: One year; a new request and academic verification are required for another year.
restrictions: Academic use only; not permitted in a corporate environment. No technical support is included. Manual review can take several business days.

name: Deepnote Education Plan
benefit: Free education workspace with most Team collaboration features and unlimited Basic compute hours per member (up to 5 GB RAM and 2 vCPU).
eligibility: Students, teachers and researchers link a valid school email to their Deepnote account.
duration: While approved for the academic Education plan.
restrictions: Advanced compute machines, scheduling and Deepnote AI are not included. Higher compute tiers/GPU require a payment method.

name: DeepScan Student Trial
benefit: Six months of DeepScan JavaScript/TypeScript code analysis access through the GitHub student benefit.
eligibility: Verified GitHub Student Developer Pack members.
duration: Six-month student promotional trial.
restrictions: This is a fixed-duration trial, not a permanent free tier; product limits and paid renewal terms apply.

name: DevCycle Starter for GitHub Students
benefit: One year of DevCycle Starter with unlimited seats, feature flags and usage for feature-flag management.
eligibility: Verified members of the GitHub Student Developer Pack.
duration: One-year promotional Starter subscription; not a permanent free-tier allowance.
restrictions: Redemption requires GitHub Student Developer Pack eligibility. After the year, check the current plan and charges before continuing.

name: Doppler Team for Students
benefit: Free Doppler Team secret-management subscription, normally priced at US$21 per user per month.
eligibility: Must be an active verified GitHub Education student and activate through Doppler's student program.
duration: While eligible as an active student, subject to GitHub and Doppler partner terms.
restrictions: Github Education eligibility must remain active; do not interpret the student entitlement as a public unrestricted Team plan.

name: Figma for Education
benefit: Eligible classroom students and educators can access Figma Education features and a monthly AI-credit allocation.
eligibility: Current students and classroom educators must verify with a school email; selected structured bootcamps and academies may qualify.
duration: Subject to ongoing educational eligibility and program conditions.
restrictions: Available only in select regions; some AI and publishing features are limited. Non-teaching school staff, self-study and startups do not qualify.

name: Firecrawl Student Program
benefit: One-time grant of 10,000 Firecrawl API credits for web crawling and data extraction.
eligibility: Currently enrolled students with a valid academic email address at a college, university or accredited program.
duration: One-time promotional credit grant, not a recurring monthly allowance.
restrictions: Credits are intended for educational or personal projects; use the official student coupon workflow. Check provider terms for expiration and usage restrictions.

name: GitHub Copilot Student
benefit: Free access to Copilot Student features for verified GitHub Education students.
eligibility: Verify eligible student status through GitHub Education; activation is separate from approval.
duration: Eligibility is reevaluated monthly.
restrictions: Some features and premium limits are plan-dependent. Do not purchase if only paid signup appears; check approval/activation status.

name: GitHub Copilot for verified teachers
benefit: Free GitHub Copilot Pro access for verified GitHub Education teachers.
eligibility: Educators, faculty or researchers must apply through GitHub Education and verify institutional affiliation.
duration: While verified and eligible, subject to GitHub's program terms.
restrictions: Teacher approval is required. This is a conditional educational benefit, not a general Copilot Free-plan quota.

name: GitHub Student Developer Pack
benefit: Access to a changing collection of partner developer tools, learning resources, subscriptions and promotional credits through GitHub Education.
eligibility: Verified current students aged 13+ in a qualifying degree- or diploma-granting program with a personal GitHub account.
duration: GitHub Education student verification lasts up to two years; individual partner offer durations vary.
restrictions: Partner offers have separate eligibility, country and usage rules; one-time offers generally cannot be redeemed repeatedly or stacked. Not available to faculty through the Student Pack.

name: GitKraken Student Plan
benefit: Six months free access to GitKraken Desktop, GitLens, CLI and developer tools with Pro-style features.
eligibility: Verified GitHub Student Developer Pack members sign up using or connect the qualifying GitHub identity.
duration: Six months free; then an optional 75–80% student discount on Pro while eligible.
restrictions: One individual seat; AI token limits apply. A payment method may be requested, so check renewal and cancel before paid billing if not continuing.

name: GoDaddy Empower for Students
benefit: One standard .com domain and an AI-powered website builder with commerce features at no charge for three years.
eligibility: Students aged 18+ at participating institutions or approved programs must complete eligibility verification.
duration: Three years per approved redemption; then renewal is at prevailing retail prices.
restrictions: Limited to one domain and website per participant. No card is required to redeem, but optional auto-renew plus a payment method can cause renewal charges.

name: GoRails Student Course Access
benefit: Free access to GoRails video courses and lessons for Ruby, Rails and web development.
eligibility: Eligible GitHub Student Developer Pack students redeem the partner benefit.
duration: Twelve months of course access.
restrictions: Premium materials are included only for the promotional period; renewal or other training programs may require payment.

name: Heroku Platform Credits for GitHub Students
benefit: US$312 total in Heroku platform credits, applied at a maximum of US$13 each month for 24 months.
eligibility: Verified GitHub Student Developer Pack participants must apply for Heroku's student program.
duration: Twenty-four months; the US$13 monthly allowance does not roll over.
restrictions: Credits exclude third-party add-ons. Monthly charges above US$13 can be billed to the payment card; credits cannot be consumed all at once.

name: Honeybadger Small for Students
benefit: One year of Honeybadger Small monitoring for application errors, uptime checks and cron jobs.
eligibility: Verified GitHub Student Developer Pack members claiming the Honeybadger student partner offer.
duration: One year of the Small account.
restrictions: Service quotas are those of the Small plan, not an unlimited account; check billing if continuing after expiration.

name: Icons8 Student Developer Pack
benefit: Three months of access to eligible Icons8 icons, illustrations, photos and music through the student license.
eligibility: Verified GitHub Student Developer Pack membership; redeem through Icons8 with GitHub sign-in.
duration: Three-month student subscription.
restrictions: Only the licensed asset library and permitted uses are included; read asset licensing and subscription renewal terms.

name: IconScout Student Pack
benefit: Up to 60 premium icons per month from selected IconScout contributors, plus unlimited eligible free assets.
eligibility: GitHub Student Developer Pack members sign in to IconScout with the verified GitHub account.
duration: One year of student-plan access; premium selection resets monthly.
restrictions: Not all premium contributors or asset types are eligible. Asset-license conditions remain applicable.

name: JetBrains Student and Teacher Pack
benefit: IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate, ReSharper and other JetBrains IDEs and .NET tools under an educational license.
eligibility: Students and faculty at accredited institutions; student study programs generally must be long-term and full-time.
duration: Free while educational eligibility remains valid; renewal/verification required.
restrictions: Educational licenses may not be used for commercial work. Short-term bootcamps are generally ineligible.

name: Kiro for Students
benefit: 1,000 Kiro credits each month for 12 months, with IDE, CLI and eligible premium agent features included at no cost.
eligibility: Students aged 18+ at participating universities must use their university-linked email and verify through SheerID.
duration: 12 months; the balance resets each month, with no rollover; then reverts to Kiro Free.
restrictions: Only listed participating universities qualify. No credit add-ons on this student tier, and the one-time student verification cannot be repeated.

name: LocalStack Student Cloud Emulator
benefit: Student license to LocalStack's advanced AWS service emulation in a ready-to-use cloud environment.
eligibility: Verified GitHub Student Developer Pack members accessing the LocalStack partner offer.
duration: While the qualifying student benefit remains available; no specific public duration in the Pack listing.
restrictions: This is an emulator, not AWS cloud service credit. Availability and feature scope can change; use the partner redemption terms.

name: MongoDB Student Pack
benefit: One-time US$50 MongoDB Atlas cloud credit plus free certification after completing an eligible learning path.
eligibility: Approved GitHub Student Developer Pack members verify their student status with MongoDB.
duration: Promotional Atlas credit must be applied within 90 days; usable for 12 months once applied.
restrictions: Credit redeems once at organization level. Paid clusters can incur further charges after the credit; certification requires completing the learning path.

name: Namecheap NC.ME Student Domain
benefit: One standard .me domain registration at no cost for the first year under the NC.ME education promotion.
eligibility: Students at eligible universities with a verified institutional academic email.
duration: One-year registration; renewals are not automatically free.
restrictions: Eligibility and domain availability depend on the approved institution and TLD. Domain renewal or optional services may be charged.

name: Name.com GitHub Student Domain
benefit: One eligible domain under selected TLDs, plus Domain Safe, free for its first registration year.
eligibility: Approved GitHub Student Developer Pack members redeem through the Name.com student promotion.
duration: One year free for the eligible registration.
restrictions: Only selected extensions qualify; normal renewal and optional service fees apply after the free period. Valid domain contact information is required.

name: Navicat Academic Partner Student License
benefit: One-year noncommercial academic access to eligible Navicat Premium, Data Modeler, Monitor and Cloud Pro products.
eligibility: Students at accredited nonprofit high schools, universities or community colleges with a valid student email.
duration: One year; standard student application is limited to one redemption per student.
restrictions: Not for commercial use or third-party benefit. Unaccredited institutions and training centers do not qualify.

name: New Relic for Students
benefit: Student access to New Relic application observability tools under the GitHub Education offer (advertised value US$300/month).
eligibility: GitHub Student Developer Pack members who activate New Relic's student offer.
duration: While eligible as a student, subject to the partner program.
restrictions: Advertised value is not a cash credit or guarantee of unlimited ingest. Confirm account usage limits and any paid overages with New Relic.

name: Notion Education Plan
benefit: Free Education plan for a one-member workspace, with unlimited uploads, 30-day version history and up to 100 guests.
eligibility: Students or educators at accredited colleges and universities recognized by WHED, using a valid primary institutional email.
duration: Reverify the education email annually to retain the benefit.
restrictions: Not offered to K-12 users under this higher-education plan. Extra workspace members disqualify the individual plan; losing eligibility returns to Free.

name: Office 365 Education A1
benefit: Free Office 365 A1 online productivity applications, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint, through eligible schools.
eligibility: Students and educators with a qualifying educational email address at a verified school.
duration: While enrolled or employed at an eligible institution; Microsoft may recheck eligibility.
restrictions: Web-based A1 is not the same as a paid Microsoft 365 desktop/personal subscription. Institutional access ends when academic eligibility is lost.

name: POEditor Plus for GitHub Students
benefit: One year of the POEditor Plus plan for translation and localization management, at no subscription cost.
eligibility: Verified GitHub Student Developer Pack members redeem through the official POEditor GitHub Education registration.
duration: One-year student promotional subscription.
restrictions: Student eligibility and Plus-plan limits apply; do not treat this as free unlimited enterprise localization.

name: PopSQL Premium for Students
benefit: PopSQL Premium collaborative SQL editor subscription free for eligible students.
eligibility: Students who claim the PopSQL benefit from GitHub Student Developer Pack.
duration: While verified as an eligible student, subject to continued partner offering.
restrictions: Student-only Premium entitlement; verify product availability, workspace features and renewal with the provider.

name: Qt Educational License
benefit: Free access to Qt professional commercial development/design features for educational projects, including Qt for Developers or Designers packages.
eligibility: Students or instructors at recognized higher education institutions with an active institutional email.
duration: 12 months; renewable through an eligibility renewal process.
restrictions: Strictly for learning; no commercial use or commercial distribution. No professional technical support is included.

name: Reclaim Education Discount
benefit: 50% off an eligible paid Reclaim scheduling plan for up to 12 months.
eligibility: Students, educators and school administrators at accredited degree-granting nonprofit educational institutions, age 13+.
duration: Up to 12 months on approved monthly or annual subscriptions.
restrictions: This is a paid discount, not a free plan; Enterprise is excluded. Apply with a school email and wait for approval.

name: Sentry Team for Students
benefit: Student Team features with allowances listed by the partner: 50,000 errors, 100,000 transactions, 1 GB attachments and 500 replays.
eligibility: Verified GitHub Student Developer Pack members claiming the Sentry student offer.
duration: One year per term, potentially renewable with renewed eligibility.
restrictions: On-demand paid usage is disabled in this offer; quotas are capped and renewal needs student verification.

name: Simple Analytics Starter for Students
benefit: One year of Simple Analytics Starter, including up to 100,000 pageviews per month.
eligibility: Verified GitHub Student Developer Pack members claiming the partner offer.
duration: One year; the pageview allowance renews monthly during the free term.
restrictions: Only Starter-level features and pageview thresholds are included; after the promotional year paid pricing may apply.

name: SQLGate Standard for Students
benefit: Access to most SQLGate Standard subscription features for SQL database management at no charge.
eligibility: Verified GitHub Student Developer Pack members must activate with GitHub.
duration: One year of student access.
restrictions: Only most Standard features are included; not the full unrestricted subscription. Terms after the first year may differ.

name: .TECH Domain for GitHub Students
benefit: One standard .TECH domain name free for one year through the GitHub Student Developer Pack.
eligibility: Verified GitHub Student Developer Pack members redeem the partner domain offer.
duration: First registration year only.
restrictions: Premium domains may be excluded and later renewals are paid at the provider's prevailing rate.

name: Termius Pro and Team for Students
benefit: Full Termius Pro and Team features for SSH management, cross-device synchronization and team sharing at no charge.
eligibility: An active GitHub Student Developer Pack is required; connect the eligible GitHub account to Termius.
duration: While an eligible and active GitHub Student Developer Pack member, subject to partner terms.
restrictions: Verification and partner entitlement required; this is not an unrestricted general free plan.

name: testmail.app Essential for Students
benefit: Free Essential plan during eligible studies with up to 10,000 test emails per month, full API access and 1–3 day message retention.
eligibility: Verified active students redeem the Essential plan through GitHub Student Developer Pack.
duration: While the user remains an eligible student under the partner offer.
restrictions: A single random namespace and limited message retention apply. Not the same as the provider's separate ongoing Free plan (100 emails/month).

name: Tower Pro for Students
benefit: Full Tower Pro Git desktop client for macOS and Windows without subscription payment during the qualifying year.
eligibility: Students at accredited colleges/universities; verify via GitHub Student Developer Pack or academic email and evidence.
duration: Twelve months, renewable on successful re-verification of student status.
restrictions: No payment card required. Free access expires when eligibility cannot be renewed; existing paid fees are not refunded.

name: Working Copy Pro for Students
benefit: Unlocks the Pro features of the Working Copy Git client on iPhone and iPad, normally sold as an in-app purchase.
eligibility: Students verified through the GitHub Student Developer Pack must sign in with the same GitHub account in the iOS app.
duration: While logged in with an eligible student GitHub account.
restrictions: iPhone/iPad application only; entitlement depends on active GitHub Student Developer Pack status.

name: Xojo Pro Student License
benefit: Free Xojo Pro license for building cross-platform native desktop, mobile and web applications.
eligibility: Students with an active and verified GitHub Student Developer Pack benefit.
duration: While eligible as a student under the partner offer.
restrictions: Not an unrestricted organization subscription; verify licensing and deployment rights with Xojo.

name: Zed Student Pro
benefit: Zed Pro free for 12 months with unlimited edit predictions, collaborative editing, and US$10 in hosted AI token credits each month.
eligibility: Currently enrolled university students aged 18+; apply with a GitHub account at least 30 days old and a current university email.
duration: One year after approval; included monthly AI credits reset each month.
restrictions: Some premium models are excluded; verification and plan eligibility required. Unused monthly credits do not accumulate.
